text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—For some reason, Trainer... You seem to 
be attracting "unpleasant things" today.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So, after this... would you mind holing up 
in the trainer's office... until tomorrow 
morning...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm right here with you, so please don't 
worry... I will... protect you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe isn't the kind of girl to 
tell lies just to scare people. I decided 
to listen to her suggestion—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As night fell and I was working while 
Manhattan Cafe was in the room—

――Trainer-san! So this is where you were! 
It's me! Tazuna!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa?
text_block_list.text:
I have something urgent to discuss 
regarding the training track! Could you 
please open the door?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ――You must not answer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. It's here.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The more you respond, Trainer... the 
easier it is for that child to cross... 
the boundary... Just stay quiet like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa?
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Why won't you open up? You can 
hear me, can't you? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa?
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Trainer? Trainer? Trainer? 
Trainer? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(THUMP-THUMP-THUMP-THUMP-THUMP-THUMP-THUMP! 
BANG-BANG-BANG-BANG-BANG-BANG-BANG-BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the frantic pounding on the door 
echoes around me, I maintain my silence 
just as Manhattan Cafe instructed, and 
then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――SWISH)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the lights in the Trainer's 
Office cut out. But that wasn't the only 
strange thing happening.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Rattle-rattle-rattle! Clonk, crack, 
clatter!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Strange noises begin to echo from all 
around the trainer's office. It's almost 
as if... a massive force from outside is 
shaking the room.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, make your choice. Will you 
endure this until morning...? Or————settle 
this right now?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you wish, Trainer... it may be a bit 
forceful, but... I can drive that child 
away... right now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No matter which one you choose... I won't 
let any harm come to you...
choice_data_list: I'll endure it like this until morning.
Let's get this settled all at once.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. Excuse me, then————

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe takes my hand. I can feel a 
profound warmth radiating from her palm...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Please... feel my warmth... Listen... 
only to my voice..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, I'm sure... I won't be... 
scared of anything anymore...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, led by the hand by Manhattan Cafe, 
the two of us sat down side by side on 
chairs. The surrounding clamor drifted 
further and further away—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it, the outside had grown 
bright, and the trainer's room was 
enveloped in the quiet of early morning.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's all right now. She gave up and 
left... I don't think she'll ever... 
appear again...
choice_data_list: Thank you for always protecting me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No. I only did... what I could...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I experienced some bone-chilling moments, 
but thanks to Manhattan Cafe, I was able 
to watch the sunrise with a warm heart...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Then please, believe in me 
and watch over me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Manhattan Cafe began walking 
and opened the Trainer's Office door 
without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From beyond the door, an indescribable, 
eerie sound rips through the air, echoing 
outward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe called out something toward 
the sound. Yet for some reason, I couldn't 
make out a single word――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The very next moment, the lights in the 
Trainer's office came back on, and silence 
returned...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's all right now. She gave up and 
left... I don't think she'll ever... show 
up again...
choice_data_list: What on earth did you do?
What on earth did you do?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
……I merely "observed" and spoke to her. 
That child retains her power…… by not 
being seen, after all……

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
…………Thank you for your hard work, Trainer. 
I'm sorry…… for scaring you…….
choice_data_list: If anything, thank you for protecting me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please... I only... did what I 
could...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it was a slightly terrifying 
experience, thanks to Manhattan Cafe's 
dependability, I was able to welcome the 
morning with peace of mind.
